note: Engineering: Apply to exams 1-10 (universal) + your state exam (11-15). Medical: NEET-UG is mandatory. Law: CLAT for NLUs, SLAT for Symbiosis. Management: CAT for IIMs, SNAP/NMAT for private B-Schools. Design: UCEED for IITs, NIFT for fashion, NID for design.
